name: Erstwhile
description: Undead creatures who helped Vraska establish herself as guildmaster.

timeline.summary: The Golgari unearth the Erstwhile's coffins and reanimate them.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have unearthed their coffins and reanimated them as part of the Swarm.

timeline.summary: The Erstwhile are unearthed and become an army for Vraska.

citation.text: Attendant of Vraska (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
